messages:
maya.cs: Quick alert 1: a subset of onboarding accounts are showing 'index pending' after our nightly ingest. Impact: ~40 trials and 6 paid onboarding customers. I\u2019m preparing a status note for customers; need ETA and mitigation options. @liam.eng can you confirm root cause and timelines?

liam.eng: Looking into it. Logs show repeated retries causing worker memory exhaustion on indexer-2. We restarted the worker and isolated the retry loop. Starting a controlled backfill with rate limits to avoid repeat OOMs. Best-case ETA 2-4 hours for most accounts, longer if we hit more hot shards.

devops-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2024-4892. indexer-2 OOM, restarted 2024-11-23T02:14Z. Current backlog ~9.8k docs. Telemetry: https://dash.internal/indexer-2

nina-se: For customer comms I recommend: brief incident note, expected recovery window, how to request manual import, and a goodwill offer. We should differentiate trials vs paid (trial: 1 mo credit; paid: priority SE time + tailored credit case-by-case).

maya.cs: Draft message (please edit):
```
Hi {Name},
We detected a temporary delay in indexing for some onboarding accounts this morning. Our engineers are performing a manual catch-up and monitoring to ensure data is fully indexed. Most affected accounts should see completion within the next 2-4 hours.
If you'd like immediate assistance, reply and we can run a manual import for you. As an apology for the disruption we\u2019re offering a one-month service credit to impacted trial accounts; paid customers will receive priority SE time and a tailored credit if needed.
We\u2019ll share hourly updates and a short post-incident summary once resolved.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference CS
```

jess-support: I can send this to the affected list in the next 15m. Also setting up a 3pm PST "indexing triage" office hours link and adding it to the message. Will capture all replies here.

omar.pm: Sounds good. Hold enterprise credit decisions until we have final scope; flagging renewal-risk customers: VertexHealth, Nimbus Labs, BlueForge (these have upcoming renewal renewals in 30-60d). Carlos from sales should be looped for any escalations.

carlos-sales: Thanks @omar.pm. I\u2019ll be on call for any exec escalations. If any of the high-touch accounts request early demos or extended trials, ping me and I\u2019ll coordinate.

liam.eng: Backfill started: 0% -> 40% after 20m. Reduced concurrency to prevent OOMs; throughput slower but steady. If we finish main backfill without errors we can run a targeted shard sweep for stragglers.

maya.cs: OK team: hourly status posts to customers, CS to triage replies and collect requests for manual import, sec/eng to monitor and post catch-up progress. If any flagged renewal accounts escalate, well prep bespoke outreach and credit options.

nina-se: Agree. Also ask customers whether they observed missing search results vs missing ingestion entirely; that affects remediation steps.

jess-support: First wave sent to top 20 impacted accounts. Two replies so far: one asks for manual import, one asks "how will this affect our demo scheduled tomorrow?" I replied that we\u2019ll prioritize them and looped sales. Pasting replies: 
- AcmePilot: "Please run manual import asap, demo tomorrow morning."
- OpenGov: "Are you likely to finish before EOD? We have a demo at 4pm."

liam.eng: Progress update: 68% complete (45m). No further OOMs after throttle changes. ETA revised: majority done in ~90 minutes.

maya.cs: Thanks. Action items:
1) Eng: finalise backfill + confirm when each flagged account is reconciled (liam.eng)
2) CS: continue hourly comms + track manual import requests (jess-support, nina-se)
3) PM: hold enterprise credit until final impact scope (omar.pm)
4) Sales: prep potential customer escalations and executive note (carlos-sales)
5) Post-incident: RCA + customer summary + list of impacted accounts (maya.cs/omar.pm)

liam.eng: Final update: backfill complete for 92% of accounts; remaining items are on a small hot shard we\u2019re sweeping now. Will post final completion in-thread once that shard is done.

maya.cs: Final: cleanup done at 2024-11-23T05:09Z. All impacted accounts reconciled. Preparing post-incident summary + targeted outreach for renewal-risk customers. Thanks everyone.
